name: ST3215 / ASW-07D · Case panel · INTERTOOL BX-0151
description: A 214 × 150.6 mm front-down faceplate with R4 corners with seven side-wall M3 mounts, a continuous ARM 1 / servo / ARM 2 cassette shifted 12 mm left, and a honeycomb-lightened universal 20 mm M3 base with seven removable electronics adapters. Four 50 mm brass standoffs carry the mechanism and four 40 mm standoffs carry the spring-clip housing; recessed floor screws anchor them and four M3 x 15 lid screws retain the cassette; the registered spring-clip housing uses nylon ties. A straight wall below it supports the vertical PWM module with two ties and a compact keeper. Yellow aligns midway between the battery rows and the SP20 pair. ARM1/ARM2 are engraved on the enlarged cassette; I/R/P mark the red/yellow/green indicators, TS/PS sit to the right of the SP20 pair, and ICT sits above the clips. A fitted servo cradle, independent braced converter adapters, closed battery guide pockets and XT60 reaction stops provide direct support. HAT, Heltec, ADS1220 and both LC filters have separate replaceable adapters; board changes leave the universal base unchanged. XT60E-M fits from below into flange pockets; M2.5 screws enter from the front through shallow head recesses into its embedded nuts. The left wall uses one central screw. Fit the delivered hardware before fabrication.
